name: focus-pet-scripts
description: Research data tooling for the Focus Pet study. Kept out of the web app so firebase-admin never reaches the browser bundle.
comment_overrides: uuid is pinned at 9.x deep under gaxios (via @google-cloud/storage) and carries a moderate advisory. Nothing here uses Cloud Storage, but the override removes the finding rather than leaving it to be re-triaged every time someone runs npm audit.
